notes: N-14 (filed 2021-02-05) combined information statement/prospectus for an open-end fund reorganization: MainStay Epoch U.S. All Cap Fund (series of MainStay Funds Trust) into MainStay WMC Enduring Capital Fund (series of The MainStay Funds). No shareholder vote: 'The Reorganization does not require shareholder approval', so there is no meeting date and shareholder_approval is not a condition. The filing defines a 'Record Date' of March 15, 2021 (Appendix E) only for counting outstanding shares, not for a vote, so record_date is left null. security_class 'other': the securities are multiple open-end share classes (Class A, Investor, B, C, I, R6), exchanged class-for-class at NAV. A separate reorganization of MainStay MacKay U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund into the same Acquiring Fund is mentioned (also expected on or about April 26, 2021) but is not contingent on this one and is not this filing's transaction, so n_targets = 1. No tickers are printed. No outside termination date: the Plan may be terminated by board resolution at any time before closing. conditions 'other' covers accuracy of representations/warranties and the target's pre-closing dividend declaration.
